dateBasis: US exchange calendar dates (Eastern Time); end-of-day marks
method: period_total = delta(realized_cumulative) + delta(unrealized); start baseline is the previous calendar day end
openingBasis: 2025-12-31 unadjusted OpenD close; 2026 purchases use price plus verified fees; moving-average basis
excluded: small Moomoo gift/fractional positions other than NVDA

moomoo.label: Moomoo 美股
moomoo.source: OpenD history_deal_list_query + order_fee_query + unadjusted daily bars

mplus.label: M+ 美股
mplus.source: 2025-12 and 2026-01 to 2026-09 M+ statements (holdings/trades/fees); OpenD daily marks

notes.headlineDifference: This period module independently rebases BOTH brokers to 2025-12-31 US close. The existing headline retains its original lifetime-cost / statement-mark methodology and is not strict YTD.
notes.transactionDates: OpenD uses US exchange time; M+ trades use the trade dates printed on statements. Nontrading days carry the previous valid close; assignment fills on nontrading days still change the inventory.
